notes.title: Marble Champions rolls onto Steam July 24!
notes.notes: [p]Marble Champions, the new game of the creator of Spiral Splatter is now out on Steam![/p][p] [/p][p]Marble Champions is a fast-paced marble racer that combines precision racing with unpredictable chaos and creative freedom. The game blends physics-based control, competitive racing, and party-style chaos into one uniquely marble-powered experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]Trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="gFAF6f80aOk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Features[/b][/p][p][b]Fast-Paced Marble Racing:[/b] Master your marble's speed, balance, and boosts across ramps, tight corners, drops, moving platforms, and surprise hazards.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Rise through the ranks:[/b] Enter the Marble League with a varied selection of procedurally generated race events.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Collect ’Em All:[/b] Unlock a wide roster of unique marbles, each with different stats adapted to various styles of gameplay.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Tournaments:[/b] Enter pre-designed tournaments with multiple tracks and unlock special marbles if you take home the trophy.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Time Trials:[/b] Race against the clock (and ghosts) to shave seconds off your time in community created tracks and reach the top of the global leaderboards.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Battles: [/b]Knock marbles out of the arena in the battle mode and compete in various mini games like free for all, marble royale, Orb collector, and survival.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Daily Trials:[/b] Face new challenges every day with rotating time trial levels. Compete for the top spot on global leaderboards to win prizes and unlock new marbles.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Local Multiplayer:[/b] Compete with friends in [b]local multiplayer[/b], with up to four marbles.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Creative Track Designer:[/b] Design and share your own tracks using the intuitive track designer.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Marble Show:[/b] Set up a course and let the show unfold. Watch marbles race in a hands-off mode designed for fun, party environments, and stream-ready entertainment.[/p][p] [/p][p]Get the game now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715940"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Spiral Splatter update V1.0.2
notes.notes:
- The ball is now slightly smaller.
- Tweaked the timers on the "Door" and "Move Object" triggers.
- The cursor is now hidden while dragging the ball.
- Fixed some issues with the animations in Stage 7 levels.
- Increased the font-size for the text on the timer triggers.
- Fixed a collision bug on Level 10-4
- Fixed an issue where the UI would become unresponsive after trying to play a locked level.
- Fixed an issue where the game would not correctly restart while the ball is in a portal.
- Fixed an issue where the achievement "Complete all levels" would unlock while some levels have not yet been completed.
- Fixed some interface issues while using a controller in the "Level Select" screen.
